text:
Brayden McNabb is 35, an original Golden Knight with 668 games in Vegas and a 2023 Stanley Cup ring, and he is still eating 20 minutes a night on a good team. He doesn't score (no goals in 21 games, eight assists) and he never really has. That isn't the job.

The job is keeping the puck away from his net, and it's going well. Vegas takes 57% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on, seven points better than without him. Evolving-Hockey had him 91st percentile last season at taking chances away, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him stopping 16% of the entries aimed at him, against a typical 11%. His minutes have gone up over the last ten games, more than three a night.

He is not fast (bottom 6% for top speed, no recorded bursts over 20 mph), and he gets there with reads and reach instead. Eight points already, against 12 in all of last season, and that pace is ahead of what our range expects. Enjoy the points if they keep coming. The value is everything else.
